# dopeIPTV

> dopeIPTV is a free, open-source desktop IPTV player for Xtream Codes, M3U playlists and Stalker / Ministra portals. It has a full EPG (XMLTV) guide, pause and rewind on every live channel, catch-up TV, one-click recording, and multiview for up to nine channels at once — all in one native app built on the mpv engine. It is made for Linux and also runs on macOS and Windows.

Key facts:

- **What it is:** a desktop IPTV *player* (client), not an IPTV provider. It does not supply, sell or host any channels or content — the user connects their own Xtream Codes, M3U or Stalker portal provider.
- **Licence & price:** free and open source under GPL-3.0. No ads, no tracking, no accounts.
- **Platforms:** Linux (primary; AppImage and .deb for x86_64 and ARM64, Flatpak for x86_64), macOS (.dmg, Apple Silicon and Intel), Windows (portable build, x64 and ARM64).
- **Playlists:** Xtream Codes (server + username + password), M3U / M3U8 URLs and Stalker / Ministra portals (portal URL + MAC address; experimental); multiple providers side by side. Free demo channels to try it without an account.
- **Guide & timeshift:** full XMLTV EPG with now/next that keeps itself up to date; pause and rewind any live channel (minutes in memory, up to 6 hours on disk, or with dopeIPTV's own buffer, which keeps downloading while paused — experimental); catch-up into a provider's archive.
- **Recording:** record the watched stream over a single connection, with timers, size limits and a Recordings library; with dopeIPTV's own buffer, recordings come from the buffer and stay whole while paused.
- **Home:** a start page with this week's most popular films and series the provider has (TMDB's weekly chart), continue watching, favourite channels with what is on now, and new episodes of followed series.
- **Multiview:** watch up to nine live channels at once in a grid, with per-window timeshift and subtitles.
- **Extras:** built-in mpv player, casting to Chromecast and DLNA/UPnP smart TVs, subtitles from OpenSubtitles.com, desktop media controls and media keys (MPRIS), new-episode alerts for followed series, Trakt watched-history sync, TMDB metadata and artwork, 25 themes (dark, light, and some with a colour of their own) with accent colours, test builds for early adopters, full keyboard control, and an interface available in 26 languages besides English (with right-to-left support for Arabic, Hebrew, Persian and Urdu).
- **Developer / owner:** the slimture/dopeIPTV project on GitHub.

## Main pages

- [Home / overview](https://iptv.dope.rs/): features, screenshots and downloads.
- [Features](https://iptv.dope.rs/#features): EPG, timeshift & catch-up, pause live TV, recording, multiview, multi-provider, playback, local files, casting to TVs, subtitles, media keys, following a series.
- [Download](https://iptv.dope.rs/#download): latest builds for Linux, macOS and Windows, generated from the GitHub releases.
- [About dopeIPTV](https://iptv.dope.rs/help/#about): short answers to common questions - what it is, whether it is free, where channels come from, systems and languages.
- [Troubleshooting](https://iptv.dope.rs/help/#fix): common problems and how to fix them (sign-in, expired subscription, connection limit, another device on the account, VPN blocks).
- [Help](https://iptv.dope.rs/help/): setup (Xtream, M3U, Stalker portals), playback, rewinding live TV, the guide, timeshift, recording, multiview, casting, Home, test builds and troubleshooting.

## Source & documentation

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/slimture/dopeIPTV): source code, issues and releases.
- [Releases](https://github.com/slimture/dopeIPTV/releases): all downloadable builds and changelogs.
- [Readme / docs](https://github.com/slimture/dopeIPTV#readme): documentation and setup.
- [Licence (GPL-3.0)](https://github.com/slimture/dopeIPTV/blob/main/LICENSE): licence text.

## Credits (third-party projects)

- Playback: [mpv](https://mpv.io) and [FFmpeg](https://ffmpeg.org).
- Interface: Qt and [PyQt6](https://www.riverbankcomputing.com/software/pyqt/).
- Casting: [PyChromecast](https://github.com/home-assistant-libs/pychromecast) (Google Cast); DLNA/UPnP TVs with the Python standard library.
- Subtitles: [OpenSubtitles.com](https://www.opensubtitles.com) REST API.
- Metadata & artwork: [The Movie Database (TMDB)](https://www.themoviedb.org).
- Watched sync: [Trakt](https://trakt.tv).
